summary.oneLiner: FY26 saw severe margin compression from 20% rupee depreciation, LPG-driven production shutdowns, and inventory gluts, but FY27 outlook is turning positive with normalized channel inventory, new capacity in compressors and refrigerants coming online, and margin recovery expected toward 8% EBITDA margin as operating leverage returns and cost discipline takes effect.

one-line thesis: FY26 saw severe margin compression from 20% rupee depreciation, LPG-driven production shutdowns, and inventory gluts, but FY27 outlook is turning positive with normalized channel inventory, new capacity in compressors and refrigerants coming online, and margin recovery expected toward 8% EBITDA margin as operating leverage returns and cost discipline takes effect.
financial scorecard: revenue: -10.1% YoY (Q4); -8.6% YoY (FY26); EBITDA/margin: -43% YoY (Q4); 8.3% margin (FY26) vs 10.7% (FY25); PAT (rptd): -56% YoY (Q4); -33.4% YoY (FY26); PAT (normalized): adjusted for INR120cr Q4 one-offs (LPG + truck loss + forex), normalized PAT would be ~INR184cr (Q4); order book: strong visibility in washing machines; net debt: elevated due to working capital stress (INR1,600cr inventory at FY26 end), expected to normalize to <INR900cr by June 2026.
guidance: revenue growth: better than industry (FY27); margin: targeting 8% EBITDA margin (FY27); order inflow: robust in washing machines (30-35% growth expected); capex/commissioning: INR400cr FY27 capex; compressor facility (Supa) to commission Q4FY27; refrigerant plant (Sri City) to commission Q4FY27; washing machine expansion (Greater Noida) already operational.
order book & pipeline: Strong order visibility in washing machines; compressor and refrigerant facilities have anchor customer commitments; no specific order book value disclosed.
segment / subsidiary detail: RAC revenue: -12% YoY (Q4); +9% YoY (FY26); Washing machines: +70% YoY (Q4); +52% YoY (FY26); Coolers: -10.8% YoY (Q4); -8.2% YoY (FY26); Goodworth Electronics (JV): +44% YoY revenue (Q4); EBITDA improved to INR6.19cr from INR0.94cr (Q4).
growth verticals / optionality: Compressor manufacturing (2M units, expandable to 4M) and refrigerant plant (Sri City) to unlock backward integration; washing machine capacity expansion; plastic molding consolidation at Salarpur to improve margins; SAP migration improving planning and inventory visibility.
margins & cost dynamics: Gross margin impacted by 250 bps in Q4 due to commodity inflation (copper, aluminum, plastics) and 20% rupee depreciation; price hikes of 10-12% implemented but partially offset by forex volatility; LPG crisis added exorbitant fuel switching costs; normalized margins expected to recover to historical averages in FY27 as pricing aligns and operating leverage returns.
capex / expansion: FY26 capex: INR785cr; FY27 guidance: ~INR400cr; major spend: INR500cr on land/building (Sri City refrigerant plant, Greater Noida WM, Salarpur molding, Kamargaon land); INR165cr on RAC machinery; INR70cr on WM machinery; INR10cr refrigerant advance; INR35cr molding/electronics; compressor plant building completed in May 2026.
capital allocation: Prioritizing strategic capex: compressors, refrigerants, WM expansion; maintaining discipline on returns; no dividend or buyback mentioned; focus on cash flow generation and working capital normalization in FY27.
risks & watch-items: FX volatility (rupee at INR95.5 vs budgeted INR94); El Nino uncertainty impacting AC season; labor shortages due to fuel cost and new Labour Code; global geopolitical risks (Gulf conflict) disrupting LPG supply; margin recovery dependent on sustained price pass-through and stable exchange rates.
management quality / tone: Cautiously optimistic; acknowledged severe FY26 headwinds but emphasized structural tailwinds (outsourcing trend, low AC penetration, energy transition); confident in new capacity execution and cost discipline; avoided giving FY27 guidance but signaled normalization and recovery.
non-obvious takeaways: LPG crisis caused 2-week shutdown in March, leading to INR300cr revenue loss; truck shortage stranded INR120cr of finished goods; forex loss of INR25.82cr in Q4 was largely due to mark-to-market on unhedged LCs at INR94.8; compressor facility requires no external approvals; 60% localization in compressors; inventory normalized from INR1,600cr (Mar) to target <INR900cr by June 2026.
